text: {"298":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle implements interning and arena allocation of compiler types to ensure their uniqueness."},"299":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle owns the type context arenas from which compiler type data is allocated during compilation."},"300":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_arena"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle uses arena storage for types, while rustc_arena implements the growable arena allocation mechanism."},"301":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle ties its type-context arena storage to the 'tcx lifetime."},"302":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle's type representations use 'tcx references whose validity is bounded by the compilation type context and its arenas."}}
